stories.title: Define Travel Burden Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define structured response schema for travel distance and duration including fields for origin, destination, distance_miles, duration_minutes, and error handling for missing route data.

stories.title: Implement Travel Distance and Time Computation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic using Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration between user location and each clinical trial site, including normalization and fallback handling for failed API responses.

stories.title: Integrate Travel Burden into Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose computed travel distance and duration through evaluate_care_facade as part of clinical trial results so downstream consumers (chat/UI) receive enriched trial data.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Travel Burden Computation
stories.description: Create unit tests for travel computation logic including edge cases (invalid locations, API failures) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from facade to service with mocked Google Routes responses.

stories.title: Batch and Optimize Google Routes API Requests
stories.description: Implement batching or sequential optimization strategy for multiple trial locations to minimize API calls, handle rate limits, and ensure consistent performance when computing travel burden across many sites.
